caption:
08:45 IST: your broker token is expired. Broker tokens expire every day under SEBI norms. Reconnect your broker each trading morning to keep monitoring active. Watch for the stale-token nudge and the connected but not armed alert at 09:20 IST. KaatDo runs a server-side kill switch on six brokers using official trade APIs.

KaatDo is a risk-management technology tool, not investment advice, and is not registered with SEBI. Broker API execution is never guaranteed.
